correctness.rationale: In the explicitly defined μ_ell(K_ab), each side-and-level class A_j,B_j is an independent set of twins, and adjacency between any two classes is complete or absent. The H=S_a×S_b vertex orbits have that form, so uniformly averaging barycentric coordinates inside each orbit sends a simplex to a simplex, preserves line segments and yields an H-equivariant PL strong deformation retraction onto the genuine H-fixed locus. The orbit-conflict graph has apex w, 2(ell+1) classes and degree two at each; following edges from w traverses every class exactly once, giving the odd cycle C_(2ell+3). For equal a=b, side-swap tau interchanges classes, averaging still commutes with W, and the merged top-level orbit is forbidden because it contains A_ell—B_ell edges; remaining orbits form precisely a path P_(ell+1). Classical path/cycle independence recurrences yield ambient/fixed homotopy formulas in all three congruence classes, including ell=1; reduced simplicial Lefschetz for the order-two swap yields trace zero if ell divisible by three and (-1)^(floor(ell/3)+1) otherwise, with rank-two positive/negative split at ell≡0. The package checker was inspected, and its finite orbit/homology/signed trace checks agree with the all-parameter graph proof rather than replacing it.
